baseline: Frozen Rv2: T v88 MIA and AIA, exact self-private mask
scoring: Latest local Sugiyama v2 matched 22-target official-shape evaluator; same saved 1000-draw estimated floors as Rv2
selection: Select each component by development mean; require >0.001 gain and no world loss >0.01. Preserve baseline otherwise. Freeze numerical source hashes before confirmation.
additional_check: Preliminary real-data replay after selection only; never select target-specific methods using released target truth.
limitations: Saved development and confirmation worlds have been used by prior research
Frozen T models retain historical fitted assets and population exposure
Mock score is not a prediction of official main-round score
Preliminary replay uses a different round and no main-round floors
github_scope: New Rv4 source, submission CSVs and evidence in existing private main; live-token ZIP local only
